method: Local peaks of isolated-vocal spectral-shape change over 30 ms plus positive level change; minimum -32 dBFS vocal gate; 72nd-percentile threshold; 240 ms minimum event spacing.

display.texture: Fine ivory noise inside original pixels below 20% luminance; source-red exclusion and 3-pixel erosion protect colored landmarks and edges
display.seedChanges: Three deterministic grains over the first five frames of each event, then held until the next event

limitations: Spectral changes are acoustic feature candidates, not recognized phonemes or exact semantic voice-change annotations. Stem artifacts remain possible.
